facts.headline: CrankGPT Makes the Physical Cost of AI Visible
facts.summary: A new hand-cranked device forces users to generate electricity manually, exposing the immense energy hidden in every query. This prototype highlights how AI demand on the grid is becoming a tangible physical constraint rather than an abstract software issue. The shift from cloud reliance to human labor underscores a fragile system where climate breakdown threatens digital continuity.
